title: Antimicrobial Resistance: Mechanisms, Spread and Selection
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching paragraphs before Part B, HTML tags removed; excludes headings, figures, tables, practice, references and UI. Total article includes headings, captions, table, practice and references; excludes SVG and zoom buttons. Counts include expandable answer text.
comparator: 2.A.02 recorded 11,569 narrative words; 2.D.10 recorded 7,560. This lesson has 17 narrative sections, each with at least 560 words in second-pass audit, covering all approved AMR mechanisms, genetic origin and selection, not merely additional practice.
scientific_checks: Official merged CSIR-DBT 2026 Unit 2.E page 3 and separate CSIR LS Unit 2.E page 2 and archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually checked; AMR explicit in revised merged syllabus, not explicit in older 2.E. Reviewed Blair et al., Darby et al., Luria–Delbrück 1943 phage study, Lederberg and Lederberg 1952, Balaban et al., Andersson and Hughes, and Melnyk et al. First self-review corrected placement of three diagrams, added horizontal-transfer and compensation visuals, and analytical MCQs. Second self-review added explicit prerequisites, clarified standard target/protection examples and checked mechanism vs genetic origin, population frequency vs count, tolerance vs MIC and limitations. Neutral illustrative census arithmetic checked: 20%,25%,5 percentage points,25% relative increase; 10%,20%;30%,30%;12%,20%; practice 20%,20%;20%,30%,10 points;30%,18–58%;10%,20%. No claims of official previous-year questions.
limitations: Two substantive editorial self-review passes, not independent external human review. Static source/diagram geometry and arithmetic checks, not a full rendered browser, mobile-device or accessibility audit. MP SET syllabus is an archived copy. Part C includes 12 analytical short-response and six MCQ items. Immediate neighbors not yet published at inspected baseline, so navigation is disabled and must be linked when neighbors are published. Pages deployment verification is separate and pending at commit.
